m.s: In a large bowl mix {yoghurt*0.5} with {cumin}, {smokedpaprika}, {turmeric}, {cinnamon}, {garlic*0.5} (finely grated), the juice of {lemon*0.5}, a glug of oil and 1 tsp salt. Add {chk_thigh} and toss to coat. Leave for at least 20 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Thinly slice {red_onion} and put it in a small bowl with {whitevinegar}, {brownsugar}, a pinch of salt and a splash of hot water. Leave for 15 minutes until bright pink and softened.
Mix the rest of the yoghurt with the rest of the garlic, finely grated, a squeeze of the remaining lemon and a pinch of salt. Keep it in the fridge until you eat.

Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan, grill pan or BBQ over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes a side, in batches if needed, until charred and cooked through (75°C in the thickest part). Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Halve {cherrytom}, chop {cucumber} and roughly chop the leaves from {parsley}. Toss together with the last of the lemon juice, a drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt.
Warm {wraps} in a dry frying pan for 30 seconds a side. Let everyone build their own: wrap, chicken, salad, pink onions and plenty of garlic yoghurt.

l: Skip the wrap and make it a bowl: chicken over salad, with the yoghurt in a little container. Add leftover rice if you have it. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF wraps, warmed in a separate pan. Everything else is naturally gluten free.
